title: St Peter's Ilmer Churchyard Plan
description: Drawn geometry and section labels for the hand-drawn churchyard survey sketch on the last page of the digitised monumental-inscriptions PDF, for recreating the plan (e.g. as an SVG). Each memorial's own plotted position is given by the col/row front matter on its file in monumental-inscriptions/, not here.

type.description: boundary = churchyard wall, path = edge of the path between sections, building = the church footprint

points.description: [col, row] integer grid-cell vertices of an open polyline (boundary, path) or closed polygon (building)
